description: Ministry of Public Administration and Management - Notification under the Section 51 of the Pension Minute dated 05th February 1934, amended by the Pension Minute (Amendment) Act, No. 13 of 1948
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Pension Minute to extend the compulsory retirement age for officers in the Sri Lanka Engineering Service. This content specifically deals with public service retirement benefits and pension regulations, which falls under the Public Service category (Type 8) for public sector service conditions and retirement benefits.
